scripts.release:android:preflight: NODE_ENV=production bun run lint && NODE_ENV=production bun run typecheck && NODE_ENV=production bun run bake:check && NODE_ENV=production bun run release:android:doctor
scripts.release:android:build:preview: NODE_ENV=production bunx eas build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.release:android:build:preview:local: NODE_ENV=production bunx eas build --platform android --profile preview --local
scripts.release:android:build: NODE_ENV=production bunx eas build --platform android --profile production
scripts.release:android:build:local: NODE_ENV=production bunx eas build --platform android --profile production --local
scripts.release:android:build:apk: NODE_ENV=production bunx eas build --platform android --profile production-apk
scripts.release:android:build:apk:local: NODE_ENV=production bunx eas build --platform android --profile production-apk --local
scripts.release:android:submit: NODE_ENV=production bunx eas submit --platform android --profile production
scripts.update:preview: NODE_ENV=production bun run runtime:check && NODE_ENV=production bunx eas update --channel preview --environment preview
scripts.update:production: NODE_ENV=production bun run runtime:check && NODE_ENV=production bunx eas update --channel production --environment production
scripts.release:revert: sh -c 'TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "no-tag"); if [ "$TAG" = "no-tag" ]; then echo "No tags found"; exit 1; fi; echo "Reverting release $TAG"; gh release delete "$TAG" --yes && git tag -d "$TAG" && git push origin ":refs/tags/$TAG"'
